commits.message:
GH-55 - Refactor sample by introducing email service as separate maven module with shared message contracts and fix core design flaw.

Separated sample application into dedicated modules (email-service, s2p-app) which revealed that consumer-only services were forced to include unnecessary transaction dependencies from spring-outbox-core.

Created spring-outbox-messaging module for lightweight message consumption:
  - Moved OutboxMethodArgumentResolver, OutboxDefaultDeserializer to messaging
  - Made rabbit/kafka modules depend only on messaging (not core)
  - Duplicated OutboxHeaders for module independence

Benefits: Consumer services avoid unnecessary transaction management dependencies,
cleaner separation between publishing (core) and consuming (messaging).
